blocks.html: Live the convenient and modern life at The Magnolia Residences

Everybody dreams of a house that is built by a trusted brand, is ideally located in a serene place, and is conveniently accessible to key establishments. As a brand known not only in building enduring addresses and resilient homes, Robinsons Residences develops brands in strategic locations ideal for family living.

Complementing the rising exciting community, composed of mixed-use complex of residential condominiums and commercial complex in New Manila, Quezon City by Robinsons Land Corporation--is the new Magnolia Residences bounded by three major roads, Aurora Boulevard, Doña Hemady Avenue, and N.Domingo Street.
Constructed where the old Magnolia House once stood, this residential condominium development lets residents enjoy a lifestyle from an area characterized by harmonious neighborhood, child-friendly ambiance, and a slower, more-relaxed pace of life—making it an ideal choice for comfortable living.

Its strategic location makes hospitals like St. Luke’s Medical Center and Cardinal Santos; schools such as Ateneo de Manila and St. Paul University; and commercial areas like shopping malls including Robinsons Magnolia, accessible in just a few minutes away.

Apart from being right beside Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Residences makes the lives of its residents more convenient by providing retail establishments and lifestyle services right in their doorstep. At the ground floor of Robinsons Magnolia Tower are lifestyle services that provide basic and pampering needs. First on the list is a go-to convenience store, Ministop, where residents can find a wide assortment of merchandises. This store is the 500th branch of Ministop in Metro Manila.
For the residents' pampering needs, Beeswax, Hue Studio Salon, and Ysa Skin and Body Experts, have it all covered.

Beeswax offers waxing and nail care that uses organic and non-toxic products that is effective and healthy for the skin. Also providing nail care services is the Hue Studio Salon. This salon is also known for its skin care and massage therapy services. On the other hand, for residents' skin care and aesthetic needs, Ysa Skin and Body Experts, founded by a dedicated dermatologist, features a wide variety of skin treatments from simple facial to botox, stem cell, and even radio frequency to achieve a sexy body.
Meanwhile, Dhalton Home, formed by a group of local interior designers, offers furniture pieces.

Apart from the lifestyle services in just an arm’s reach, Magnolia Residences also boasts of providing comfort to its residents by having open and airy spaces enhanced by modern amenities. It features one-bedroom, two-bedroom, executive two-bedroom, and three-bedroom units. Residents are enjoying the amenities in Tower B, which features a function room, a jogging path, a swimming pool, gazebos, and a library. Start living the comfortable life at the serene, upscale neighborhood of Magnolia Residences where convenience, modern living, and harmony is the way of life.
